properties.name: Salesforce
properties.description: Salesforce, Inc., is an American cloud-based software company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It is primarily known for its customer relationship management software and related applications which it delivers through a software as a service subscription business model. It also provides software for sales, customer service, marketing automation, e-commerce, analytics, artificial intelligence, agentic AI, and application development. Founded by former Oracle executive Marc Benioff in March 1999, Salesforce grew quickly, making its initial public offering in 2004. Its major acquisitions included Tableau and Slack. As of March 2026, Salesforce has a market capitalization of approximately US$186 billion. For fiscal year 2026 (ending January 31, 2026), the company reported record annual revenue of $41.5 billion. The company is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average(since 2020) and the S&P 500.

CJM is an AI-powered marketing platform that unifies data, scores users and automates real-time actions across the entire customer journey.

This score powers automations that trigger the right actions instantly: follow-ups for hot leads, budget reallocations when campaigns underperform, and alerts that help avoid wasted spend.

The platform brings together everything a team needs: a unified dashboard to see the full journey in real time, predictive scoring that identifies intent earlier, and AI insights that recommend improvements before money is wasted.

Our vision is to become the operating system for modern marketing teams: the AI co-pilot that connects data, predicts intent and executes actions when they matter most.

CJM is not just analytics. It is Your AI Marketing OS, designed to unify, score and act in real time.

entity.description:
Welcome to Structsales – where sales, marketing, customer success and AI come together.

We are in the middle of a new business revolution. AI is transforming how companies grow, make decisions, and create value – faster and smarter than ever before. To succeed, organizations need to connect sales, marketing, and customer success, and power the entire customer journey with AI.

That’s what we do. We break down silos, align teams, and use AI as the engine that drives scalable growth, better customer experiences, and competitive advantage.

As a HubSpot Diamond Partner since 2015, we’ve supported hundreds of companies in maximizing HubSpot – combining outbound sales, inbound marketing, customer success, and AI-driven insights into one growth system.

Our CEO, Oliver Lopez, is a recognized thought leader in B2B growth and AI. He has spoken on some of the biggest stages – including HubSpot’s INBOUND in Boston three years in a row – and lectures companies on how AI is reshaping the way business is done.

If you’re ready to be part of the AI revolution and transform your business – we’re here to make it happen.

entity.name: Aamplify
entity.description:
Reach Further, Grow Better.

Digital Product Marketing that delivers better revenue.

If you are a Digital Innovator wanting to take your cutting-edge product or new platform to market; or a Digital Leader wanting to transform the way you generate revenue; or a Digital Marketer looking for the services, tools and methods that will give you the edge promoting a product online – Aamplify has a range of services to help you productise, collateralise and promote.

Since 2012, we’ve been conducting hundreds of one-on-one interviews with B2B buyers about how the purchase cycle is rapidly transforming - based on new digital platforms of engagement and systems of intelligence like Hubspot, Linkedin, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram. This primary research taught us the importance of thinking small in order to achieve big results – and so we approach digital product marketing with a small-world mindset that is focused on connecting you with your audience to create waves of socially influenced revenue and a digital sales engine.

We operate as part of a Digital Transformation Partner Ecosystem focused on bringing IoT, AI, Blockchain, Big Data and Cyber Security solutions to market with leading technology brands like IBM, Microsoft and Cisco. We provide digital product marketing services that enable you to reach further and grow better, using Hubspot and an inbound marketing approach, to transform how you generate revenue at scale.

entity.name: Orkestrate
entity.description:
Orkestrate finds the most optimal retention and upsell strategy for every single customer in real time. It operates as an intelligence layer across your entire stack, analysing behavioural signals, transactional data, and insights from customer-facing agents such as chat assistants and voice interfaces. Instead of relying on predefined journeys, it continuously interprets nuance, detects shifts in intent, and dynamically determines the highest ROI action for each individual.

This is an ever-evolving Retention OS. It captures intelligence across channels, identifies emerging revenue opportunities the moment they surface, and autonomously deploys agents to execute across email, SMS, loyalty, onsite experiences, and beyond. Every customer interaction becomes adaptive, performance-driven, and individually optimised.

As commerce becomes AI-mediated and switching friction declines, retention must become autonomous. Orkestrate transforms retention from campaign management into continuous orchestration, ensuring brands do not just communicate with customers, but intelligently grow lifetime value through constant learning and real-time execution.
